_comment: Venue and per-event anchor coordinates for Travelify deeplinks, which require lat/lng/rad. Built by scripts/build-venue-geo-from-feed.mjs from the supplier feed's own Latitude/Longitude columns (added to the sheet 21 Aug 2026), validated by per-venue median with longitude sign-flip repair. events entries carry venues whose key merges more than one real ground, so each event anchors to its own row. src: supplier = the feed's coordinates, ref = carried from the previous verified table where the feed had no usable point.
